title: tasks.md Schema
description: JSON Schema for TDD task slices produced by agent-tdd in Design Spec mode. The actual file is Markdown (tasks.md), but this schema describes the semantic structure each slice must conform to.

tasks.description: Array of TDD-sized slices to implement

title.description: One-sentence behavior description (e.g., 'Add login form validation')

risk_tier.description: Risk tier for this slice. high-risk triggers conditional test-author split.

depends_on.description: List of slice numbers this slice depends on (e.g., [1, 2]). Null or omitted means no dependencies.

files.description: Source files touched by this slice (should be ≤ 3 for safe TDD isolation)

test_intent.description: One-line description of the observable behavior a test must pin down

validation_target.description: Command or manual action to validate this slice (e.g., 'npm test -- slice-1' or 'manual: navigate to /login')

ordered_steps.description: Numbered, concrete implementation steps grounded in research

notes.description: Optional notes about known risks, weak test surfaces, or constraints (optional field)
